text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, thinking it might be good to 
socialize with fellow Trainers, I visited 
a nearby Trainer's Office――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—Singing is not merely a matter of setting 
words to music.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There is meaning in it. In both the lyrics 
and the melody. Your singing is stable. 
However――

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Meaning my heart wasn't in it, right?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Look at the time. Let's continue this 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I will prepare the countermeasure. As for 
you, make sure you delve deeper into the 
lyrics.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Excuse me, Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I saw you standing there, but I have my 
own priorities to attend to.
choice_data_list:
Prioritizing the Umamusume is only 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I imagine the same holds true 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So, what's your business?
choice_data_list: Would you like to grab a meal together?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...And the place you brought me to is 
karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I see. You picked this place after hearing 
what was said earlier, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Giving a demonstration would be best.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You are quite right. Though I cannot run 
the same way an Umamusume does—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If it's singing, I should be capable of 
it. That said, I'll need an objective pair 
of eyes and ears.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. How was that?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. However, it feels as though 
my vocal projection fell a bit short.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: As expected, practice really is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Just because you are formulating a 
strategy does not mean relying solely on 
reference materials is always the correct 
approach.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Much less with her current objective: 
emotion. If one is to learn, practical 
experience is optimal.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Well then, one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... This time, I feel like my voice 
carried with a solid, clean sustain.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—Still, this time the emotional expression 
felt a bit weak.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Whew…… It is certainly easy to say, but it 
seems I still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon is awkward with her feelings. 
She just doesn't know how to express 
what's in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I must sing as an 
exemplar, so they may feel it in their 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Songs, too, have the power to touch 
people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to have you stay with me until 
I'm fully satisfied, all so I can perform 
it for her. Are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle tone surfacing amidst the sheer 
power... That song was the very embodiment 
of her devotion to Umamusume.
